Jason's shutdown handoff: **implementation and delivery PAUSED; do not auto-resume.**

**Current state:** OPEN and PAUSED; no later acceptance receipt was established by this shutdown capture. The October11 clause assessment remains the prior boundary; any dated runtime/telemetry facts in it require refresh on resume.

**Prior clause assessment (October11, not a new runtime probe):** Experiment services are Ready but all live draw/outcome/freeze/export/proof/exposure counts remain zero. Disabled deployment does not prove complete fault, kill/disable, recovery, alert routing and rollback qualification.

**Blockers:** Jason explicitly paused all implementation/delivery. The listed acceptance boundary remains unproved beyond linked historical receipts.

**Next step on explicit resume:** After explicit Jason resume, refresh exact source/live and predecessor evidence, then satisfy: Feature off means zero experiment calls; locked/armed cannot reopen readiness and emergency hold cannot actuate.

**Acceptance retained:**
- [ ] Feature off means zero experiment calls; locked/armed cannot reopen readiness and emergency hold cannot actuate.
- [ ] Normal disable/ID clear/ordinary ownership restoration requires confirmed baseline; only an explicit facility-owned emergency-safe closure may state otherwise without relabeling it baseline.
- [ ] Alerts actually fire and clear through the owning delivery route, no comparative leakage occurs, and the exact-source rollback test is consumed by #783/#641.
